name: voice-agent-config-generator
description: Build, fix, validate, and test CloudTalk VoiceAgents. Generate a save-ready VoiceAgent (Expert Mode) configuration from a plain-language description, fix or validate an existing one, and simulate a caller before it goes live — for any inbound or outbound use case. Works fully offline, or connected to your CloudTalk account (numbers, knowledge bases, tools, agents) through the CloudTalk MCP.

api_key.title: CloudTalk API key (base64)
api_key.description: Optional — leave empty to use the plugin offline. Paste the base64 of API_KEY_ID:API_KEY_SECRET from Dashboard > Account > Settings > API keys; build it with: echo -n "API_KEY_ID:API_KEY_SECRET" | base64
